Package com.github.query4j.optimizer.index

Interface IndexAdvisor

All Known Implementing Classes:
IndexAdvisorImpl
public interface IndexAdvisor
Interface for analyzing predicates and join conditions to suggest database indexes that could improve query performance. Implementations analyze query patterns, predicate selectivity, and join key usage to recommend optimal indexing strategies.
Since:
1.0.0

    • analyzeQuery

      List<IndexSuggestion> analyzeQuery(com.github.query4j.core.QueryBuilder<?> queryBuilder)
      Analyzes a query builder to suggest indexes based on predicates and joins.
      Parameters:
      queryBuilder - the query builder to analyze, must not be null
      Returns:
      list of index suggestions, never null but may be empty
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if queryBuilder is null

    • analyzePredicates

      List<IndexSuggestion> analyzePredicates(List<com.github.query4j.core.criteria.Predicate> predicates, String tableName)
      Analyzes individual predicates to suggest single-column indexes.
      Parameters:
      predicates - list of predicates to analyze, must not be null

      Returns:
      list of index suggestions, never null but may be empty
      Throws:

    • analyzeJoinConditions

      List<IndexSuggestion> analyzeJoinConditions(List<String> joinFields, String tableName)
      Analyzes join conditions to suggest composite indexes for join optimization.
      Parameters:
      joinFields - list of fields involved in joins, must not be null
      tableName - the target table name, must not be null or empty
      Returns:
      list of composite index suggestions, never null but may be empty
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if joinFields is null or tableName is null/empty

    • suggestCompositeIndexes

      List<IndexSuggestion> suggestCompositeIndexes(Map<String,Integer> columnUsagePatterns, String tableName, double threshold)
      Suggests composite indexes when multiple columns are frequently queried together.
      Parameters:
      columnUsagePatterns - map of column names to their usage frequency
      tableName - the target table name, must not be null or empty
      threshold - minimum correlation threshold for composite index suggestion (0.0 to 1.0)
      Returns:
      list of composite index suggestions, never null but may be empty
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if parameters are invalid
